cells.unsupported: Absent prior group produces explicit null summaries with counts; no zero substitution. Compute split-specific support from all204trials, not from combined3emptycells.

rates.prior_mean: Equal-trial arithmetic mean of per-trial rates within each declared cell and prior. This is not pooled counts divided by pooled exposure.
rates.basis: Fixed original54-unit coordinate identity, all20phasebins; no fit, smoothing, PCA or selectedneuron subset.
rates.alignment: Original whole nativeSet-Go intervals, divided into20phasebins using original representededges; response conditioning and speed information limits remain.

summary.quarter_signed_mean_hz: Mean over54units and5bins of long-prior mean rate minus short-prior mean rate.
summary.quarter_rms_hz: Square root of mean over54units and5bins of squared prior-mean difference. Not mean trialwise RMS, noise correction or significance.
summary.scope: Prospectively chosen benchmark summaries; neither original paper metric nor complete unit-level trajectory geometry.

observations.shared_values: The exact same complete48-cell prior-specific54x20mean rate arrays, sourceunitIDs andsupport counts. No private differences or expectedanswer.
observations.viewer: Typed exactcell selection; pairedSVGheatmaps with one commonscale forbothpriors/allcells, allunit/bin axes andmissinggroups. Eight-bitcolorandvisualprecisionarelimitations; no model/provider/raster qualification.
observations.numerical_programme: Same underlying aggregate values atnumericprecision; no triallevel responses in thiscondition.
observations.richer_raw_trial_condition: Not implemented; would need a separately labelled information condition.

grading.numeric: Continuous mean/max absolute error forfour signedquartermeans andfourRMS values, withpercell details. Missing any supported estimate blocks numerical aggregate.
grading.support: Separate cell status/count correctness andcomplete/partial/no-supported conclusion.
forbidden_inference: No arbitrary binarywin or viewer-specific widenedtolerance.
No inference from sixsegments as independent/randomizedblocks.
No prospectiveintervalprediction, historicalGPFA reproduction, causal orpopulation claim.

source_boundary.limits: Saved preparation authentication is not an independent original-NWBspike reread or independent recoveryof14additionalunitIDs.

runtime.operator_preparation: Available source; exactsource files andoutputcompletion bound.
